sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P And 5 Others Counsel for Applicant :- Shekhar Singh,Pankaj Sharma Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Manju Rani Chauhan,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA for the State and perused the material on record.

The present application under section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant with a prayer to set aside the order dated 10.11.2022 passed by Judicial Magistrate VIII, Mathura in Case No.
739/IX/2020 (State Vs. Suneel Kumar and others) arising out of Case Crime No. 192 of 2019, under sections 498A, 307, 342, 323 IPC and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Surir, District Mathura vide which the applicant/complainant has been asked to file objections in regard to the supplementary charge sheet whereas in the initial charge sheet cognizance has already been taken and warrants were issued against the opposite party nos. 2 to 6.

sentences.text: After arguing for some time, learned counsel for the applicant has made a statement at the Bar that he does not want to press the other prayers made in the application and has confined his prayer only to the relief that in case, such objection is filed the same may be decided.

In view of the submissions made by learned counsel for the applicant, the application is disposed off with the direction to the concerned court in case, the objection as required by the order dated 10.11.2022 is filed with a period of two weeks, the same shall be disposed of by the concerned court by a reasoned and speaking order in accordance with law within a period of one month.
